charcoal-ink.$description: Charcoal Ink — Primary text, dark pill button fill, heading borders — warm near-black, the only filled button color in the system

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text, ghost button background

bone.$description: Bone — Secondary canvas, subtle violet-tinted off-white for alternating sections

cutout-gray.$description: Cutout Gray — Solid offset shadow color under primary buttons and secondary surfaces

slate-mid.$description: Slate Mid — Muted body text, secondary metadata, helper copy

hairline.$description: Hairline — Subtle borders, dividers, inactive tab indicators

deep-charcoal.$description: Deep Charcoal — Input borders, slightly heavier dividers than Hairline

logo-violet.$description: Logo Violet — Brand mark gradient terminus, logo cube fill — the only saturated color in the system

lavender-trace.$description: Lavender Trace — Selected tab underline, violet hairline accents, announcement pill border — violet at whisper volume

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

inter-display.$description: Primary typeface for all UI text, body and headings alike. Single weight 400 carries the entire hierarchy through size and tracking alone — no bold, no light. The custom stylistic sets (ss01, ss07, ss08) reshape the g, a, and l terminals into a more geometric, editorial silhouette that distinguishes it from stock Inter.

aux-mono.$description: Monospaced label font for section eyebrows (e.g. 'DAY 1', 'LET'S CHAT', nav items, badge text). Sets at 14px with -0.04em tracking gives timestamps and labels a technical, archival feel against the editorial display type.

inter.$description: Secondary fallback / system-level utility text where the custom display features aren't required
